verdict.rationale: Sketch's AI page says you can take any frame and build it out in code with 1:1 visual fidelity. This works through Sketch's built-in MCP server and an external AI client of your choice, so the code itself is produced by a third-party AI. Developer handoff in the browser covers inspecting designs, not generating code. Missing for 10: component-to-code mappings linking Symbols to codebase components, detail on output quality and whether the code is shippable, independent or hands-on corroboration of production-ready code.

support.subject: As a developer, designs map to production code — component-to-code mappings or direct design-to-code output I can actually ship

citations.quote: Take any frame in Sketch and build it out in code with 1:1 visual fidelity.
Sketch includes a built-in MCP Server, a lightweight local-only web server that lets AI clients like ChatGPT or Claude interact directly with Sketch.
Connect any MCP-compatible AI client you like to Sketch.
